{{Quote|What news do you bear, Blue-Tark?''"<br />"''I regret to inform my Magister, the Jedi Knights have destroyed the drones.''"<br />"''All of them?''"<br />"''The accelerated transgenic decoy as well, sire.|Zeta Magnus and Blue-Tark|<ref name="SkyeWalkers" />}}
'''Blue-Tark''' was a [[Gender/Legends|feminine]] [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] that served under [[Geneticist/Legends|Master Geneticist]] [[Zeta Magnus]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the first weeks of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was stationed within the citadel of [[Skye/Legends|Marat V]] during her master's conquest of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Assisting the [[Zeta Magnus (clone)|clone]] of Zeta Magnus as he controlled the planet as a proxy for his progenitor and creator, Blue-Tark fled the citadel in the wake of the [[Battle of Skye|revolt]] by the native [[S'kytri]], maiming the clone in the process as he stood in the wake of the droid's ship's engines. Returning to her true master in the heart of the [[Dark Worlds]] at the [[Rennek palace]], she reported to him of the loss of the world at the hands of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="SkyeWalkers" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Blue_Four.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Concept art of Kenner's "Blue-Four"]]
Blue-Tark was originally designated as ''Blue-Four'' in [[Kenner Products|Kenner's]] canceled ''[[The Epic Continues]]'' toy line. Originally created to serve as the personal attendant of [[Atha Prime/Legends|Atha Prime]], he was meant to pilot Prime's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] ''[[Skyriver Invader|Apex Invader]]'' in battle.<ref name="Epic">''[[The Epic Continues]]''</ref> He was renamed Blue-Tark for [[Abel G. Peña]]'s ''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]'', with Tark translating to the word ''four'' in [[Thyrsian (language)|the Thyrsian tongue]]. Likewise, Blue-Tark's master was an analogue of Prime, renamed Zeta Magnus, and flew the ''[[Skyriver Invader]]''.<ref name="SkyeWalkers" />

According to Peña's endnotes for ''SkyeWalkers'', Blue-Tark's full designation is TB-1U4, although this name was not provided in the story itself.<ref name="SkyeWalkers endnotes">{{Blogspot|subdomain=abelgpena|url=2021/12/skyewalkers-clone-wars-story.html|name=The Philodoxer|text=SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story Footnotes/Endnotes, Part 4—Claustrophobic Clones, Imperial Vs. Metric, and Xenu's Paradox|date=2021-12-30}}</ref>
